editorial.purpose: Libre Baskerville for banners, sections, product and article titles.

body.purpose: Lato for navigation, product details, prices, forms and actions.

script.purpose: Caveat for brief non-essential handwritten phrases.

logo.purpose: Playfair Display supports the recreated Nilkurinji lockup only.

numeric.purpose: Space Mono for occasional short indices and approved measurements.

motion.name: overlay-panel
motion.purpose: Directional menu, search and cart movement.

motion.name: botanical-sway
motion.purpose: Separate decorative branches move out of phase like a light breeze; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove spatial motion and image zoom.

narrative.northStar: A familiar, premium Indian food storefront led by tea and grounded in the approved Nilkurinji mockups.
narrative.overview: Warm paper, forest green, the stacked sprout wordmark, a shallow tea-led photographic banner, five category medallions, compact landscape product cards and the global editorial footer. Commerce remains familiar and Shopify-authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Follow the final homepage screenshot and approved Tea, Tea Bags, Tips and Story pages.
Retain Tea, Tea Bags, Rice, Snacks and Other Foods in one Shop route.
Use accurate product packs and approved photography; concept imagery never proves product facts.
Keep header dimensions consistent and search overlays out of document flow.

Frame the desktop header, homepage hero, category row, and editorial banners with section-specific transparent tea-branch artwork; each region gets its own left/right silhouettes, and branches stay clear of controls and copy.
Build preview category medallions from a circular photo ground plus a separate transparent foreground cutout; do not clip the cutout at the circle edge.
Make mobile menu and filters open from the left and cart from the right.
Keep live data failures separate from preview assets, prices and copy.
Use blue-violet to pale mauve Neelakurinji blossoms for the Nilkurinji flower motif; preserve the true colors of other flower species used as ingredients.

rules.name: Reference authority
rules.body: The final homepage and approved page mockups take precedence over historical redesign proposals.

rules.name: Product truth
rules.body: Never infer origin, quality, health, ingredients, delivery or product facts from a visual reference.

rules.name: One storefront catalog
rules.body: All five product categories appear through the unified Shop and Shopify-backed product routes.

rules.name: Commerce clarity
rules.body: Show the selected pack, current Shopify price, availability and a familiar purchase action.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Use spacing, rules, tonal surfaces and photography for hierarchy; shadows remain restrained.

rules.name: Kurinji blossom accuracy
rules.body: Depict Strobilanthes kunthiana in blue-violet through pale mauve, with compact tubular flower clusters. Do not use white jasmine/camellia-like blossoms for the Nilkurinji flower; keep ingredient flowers species-accurate.

dos: Match the approved shallow banner and compact landscape product composition.
Show all five categories and keep Tea Bags as a category in the unified Shop.
Label illustrative prices and preview imagery clearly.
Preserve keyboard focus, 44px targets and reduced-motion support.
Show the Nilkurinji flower in its blue-violet to pale mauve range, distinct from ingredient flowers.
donts: Do not restore the rejected tea-only or Leaf-to-Cup homepage.
Do not omit rice, snacks or other foods from live catalog/search/product paths.
Do not guess merchant facts or display fabricated reviews.
Do not add an unselected payment-provider promise or enable real checkout without merchant testing.
Do not use live preview fallbacks or make generated packaging look real.
Do not represent Neelakurinji as white jasmine/camellia blossoms or describe generated flower artwork as botanically verified.
